decision: Do not implement or train a query-group coupling candidate this round. Distinct lawful mechanism exists, but current residual and marginal-direction evidence is weak; no forced recommendation.

historical_distinction: SameGroup cross-train/test label-neighbor proposal was rejected because overlap=0. That proof does not reject relationships among multiple members inside the test query set.

reports/group_residual_diagnostic.json already examined within-Group pair residuals using older reused-development OOF: product.002889, interval[-.002602,.008783], noCRF trained. It is direct prior counterevidence, not an executed equivalent model.

theory.lawful_new_information: For an individual i, other members predictions p_j summarize other members X_j; they can add conditional information relative to Xi. They add no true query labels. Zero train/test group overlap is not an impossibility proof.
theory.necessary_condition: A method must improve P(Y_i=1 | entire observed query-group features, training evidence), not merely improve a joint distribution while preserving every marginal.
theory.accuracy_objective: Expected number correct is sum_i P(Y_i=decision_i). Thus thresholding each true marginal at.5 is optimal regardless of label dependence. Joint MAP optimizes probability that the entire vector is correct, a different objective.
theory.random_effect_limit: An independent latent group random intercept with no observed query labels or feature-dependent latent likelihood cannot infer a group-specific realized transport shock from absent labels. Integrating its prior changes calibration but is not, by itself, evidence of useful query-query conditioning.
theory.CRF_limit: An Ising/CRF with fixed unaries can change marginals through other members unaries. It is an additional assumption, not a marginal-preserving copula. Positive coupling can double-count already represented common Planet/Cryo factors or push heterogeneous travelers toward consistency.
theory.avoid: Never force same labels, use observed query peer targets in inference, take jointMAP as per-row Bayes classification, or treat pseudo-labels as new ground truth.

diagnostic_design.source: Frozen whole-group out-of-fold predictions; exact dev/passenger/group IDs, NPZ SHA and same-fold membership per group checked.
diagnostic_design.pair_statistic: mean over unordered within-group pairs of(y_i-p_i)(y_j-p_j); bootstrap entire multimember groups2000times seed20261116.
diagnostic_design.marginal_direction: For s_i=2y_i-1, joint energy=sum_i logit(p_i)*y_i + beta/(n-1)*sum_{i<j}s_i*s_j. Atbeta0, derivative of each marginal p_i is2p_i(1-p_i)*mean_peer(2p_j-1). Hence summed binary marginal loglikelihood derivative is2sum_i(y_i-p_i)*mean_peer(2p_j-1). Reported per multimember row, without fitting beta or evaluating a new probability vector.
diagnostic_design.limits: All labels and splits have been reused adaptively; bootstrap does not correct selection bias or dependence induced by shared fitted base models. These are descriptive quantities, not independent significance tests, candidate CV, or proof of no information.

findings.coverage: Dev2829/6954 (40.68%) rows in1076multimember groups; test1937/4277(45.29%) in723 groups; maxsize8.
findings.graph_thinning: 581dev groups miss members from originaltrain roster;1119dev rows (16.09%) belong to these incomplete groups. No heldout targets or extra pseudo-predicted members were inserted.
findings.interpretation: A small positive pair-dependence estimate is compatible with zero and provides almost no positive common-coupling marginal direction for rawMitra; one fold goes opposite. This is insufficient grounds for the proposed next experiment, not universal rejection of graph learning.

strict_boundaries_if_revisited: Predeclare original6954dev, outerGroupCV20261112 threefold and originalrawMitra recipe. Group membership only identifies query sets; all outer-query labels remain scoring-only.

Inside each outertraining pool, create three innerGroup folds. Fit base/preprocessing on innertraining only and predict entire inner-query groups to obtain unary OOF features. Every member of a training graph must share a model trained without that entire group.

Fit any coupling only from that outertraining nested OOF and its labels. It is invalid to reuse full-dev OOF as meta-training: base models for those rows may have trained on the outer-validation labels.

Predict outerquery with a fresh fulloutertraining base or exact authenticated matched cached outer probabilities. Query graphs contain query member attributes/unaries only; no labels, target-derived nodes or pseudo-likelihood conditioning on true peers.
Use exact sum-product individual marginals, not jointMAP, for maxsize8 graphs. Singletons retain exact base probabilities. Do not add a force-same rule, new relation or beta/threshold grid.
Any scalar penalty/parameterization must be frozen before fitting, and base-only matched control kept. This review does not authorize a particular beta, penalty or executable recipe.

When exporting a future eligible model, nested groupOOF and coupling must be refit within all authorizedtraining rows; test graphs use only their own known attributes/unaries. No oldholdout labels enter current development diagnostics.

Graph-size normalization and incomplete-dev-graph differences require disclosure. Adding missing heldout members predictions would need separate predeclaration and teacher training that excludes their whole group.

cost.raw_mitra: Nine new innerbase fits/inferences (3outer×3inner); three outerbase predictions may reuse exact authenticated frozenrawMitra caches. Without caches,total12base fits. Graph enumeration atsize8 hasatmost256states and should be cheap onCPU.
cost.rough_time: Orderofminutes, roughly5–10min including loading/preprocessing on thismachine; not a resourceprobe or runtimeguarantee.
cost.adapted_base: Nestedv81/v85 adaptation would add nine costly50stepfits to outertraining. Weak current evidence does not justify thosehours.
cost.reason_to_stop: Not lack of testgroup coverage or prohibitive rawMitra cost; lack of a convincing beneficial marginal signal plus a well-defined risk of optimizing the wrong joint objective.

next_action: Archive this review and avoid a newcandidate for now; do not wait for or condition the proposal on incompletev85 folds.

battle.agreement: Query-query mechanism is distinct; other membersX may add information; preserve strictnested groupOOF and use marginal inference; prior diagnostics weak, no forced recommendation.
